posts.title: NextUp Karaoke
posts.description: https://nextupkaraoke.app/ I've turned over this idea in my head for about 2 years before finally deciding to sit down and do it. All I wanted was a simple karaoke app that would let people queue up karaoke videos on youtube and play them in a sort of queue. posts.title: Why Improv is at the Heart of Great Tabletop Gaming
